manifest_contract.shape: One Lab or Factory is one coordinated work unit under its owning CTRL.
manifest_contract.delegation: CTRL routes the request to the unit coordinator. The coordinator chooses or adapts the starting Flow, hires only the Leads and Doers needed, and delegates bounded child tasks with separate independent review.

progress.source: The work unit coordinator's existing blocks.

manifest_contract.custom: Name a focused unit with its own objective, parent goal, coordinator, bounded tasks and reviewed results.

labs.name: Product Lab
labs.summary: Own the product and its viability.
labs.outcome: One viable product direction with user value, priorities, pricing, and financial constraints aligned.
guide: Frame the user value, business goal, and constraints.
Prioritize the smallest viable product direction.
Review evidence, economics, and the next decision.

labs.name: Research Lab
labs.summary: Turn research, data, and analytics into insight.
labs.outcome: One sourced or measured finding that changes a decision.
guide: Frame the question, metric, and evidence standard.
Research or analyze the smallest useful data set.
Return the finding that changes the build.

labs.name: Design Lab
labs.outcome: One selected experience with responsive and accessibility proof.
guide: Frame the user outcome and fixed constraints.
Explore and compare focused candidates.
Promote one proven experience.

labs.name: Test Lab
labs.summary: Prove it works and holds up.
labs.outcome: One accepted result with quality, reliability, security, and recovery evidence.
guide: Frame the user contract, risks, and acceptance proof.
Test representative, hostile, and recovery paths.
Accept the result or return precise corrections.

labs.name: Content Lab
labs.outcome: One publishable content system or campaign.
guide: Frame the audience and intended action.
Create and compare focused versions.
Promote one publishable result.

labs.name: Growth Lab
labs.outcome: One measured keep, change, or stop decision.
guide: Frame the behavior and success signal.
Run the smallest measurable experiment.
Keep, change, or stop from evidence.

factories.name: Software Factory
factories.summary: Build a defined deliverable through bounded tasks.
factories.outcome: A working increment with focused tests, independent review and release evidence.
guide: Choose or adapt a Flow for the deliverable and its acceptance evidence.
Delegate bounded implementation, test and review tasks.
Integrate and release the accepted increment.

factories.name: Web App Factory
factories.outcome: A working user journey with rendered desktop, mobile and interaction proof.
guide: Choose or adapt a Flow for the user journey and accepted visual direction.
Delegate bounded interface and behavior tasks; verify the rendered experience.
Integrate the independently reviewed experience and its delivery evidence.

factories.name: Game Factory
factories.outcome: A playable slice with verified mechanics, visual consistency and playtest evidence.
guide: Choose or adapt a game-studio Flow around one testable play loop.
Delegate bounded mechanics, art and playtest tasks as dependencies require.
Integrate the independently reviewed slice and verify it can be played.

factories.name: Integration Factory
factories.outcome: One working connection with contract, failure, recovery and live service evidence.
guide: Choose or adapt a Flow for the exact service, account and operation contract.
Delegate bounded connector and success, failure and recovery checks.
Integrate the reviewed connection and verify the intended live operation.

factories.name: Data Factory
factories.outcome: A reproducible transform or data product with reconciled inputs and verified outputs.
guide: Choose or adapt a Flow for the input contract, intended result and data constraints.
Delegate bounded transforms and validation of representative and invalid records.
Integrate the reviewed result and retain reproducibility and recovery evidence.

factories.name: Release Factory
factories.outcome: An accepted candidate delivered to the intended target with version and rollback evidence.
guide: Choose or adapt a Flow for the exact candidate, target and release authority.
Delegate bounded package, verification and delivery tasks using the existing release route.
Verify the delivered version and recovery path, then return the accepted release.
